'''Mondder Spaceport''' was the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of [[Mondder]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]]. It contained [[Imperial Pad 693]].
